description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the SortOption interface, including methods for creating instances, adding entries, and retrieving properties related to sorting options within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOption
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the SortOption interface, representing a list of sorting criteria with methods to manipulate and access these criteria.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableSortOption instance from a list of entries.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations based on the SortOption.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of SortOptionEntry objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new SortOptionEntry to the current options, returning a new ImmutableSortOption.

methods.name: add (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates a new SortOptionEntry from property path and order, and adds it.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the entries list is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream over the entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the entries.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sort options.
